description: SmartVisuals AI Chatbot brings conversational AI into your Power BI reports. Ask a question about your data in plain English or your own language and get an answer, a chart or a working DAX formula in seconds. AI is included: get a free license key, paste it into the visual and start chatting - no AI account, no API key, no setup. New in 1.1: answers you can check "How I got this" under every answer (free) - the fields, filters, periods and grouping actually used and how many rows went in, plus "Show rows" to see them. The visual calculates the numbers on your data; the AI does not guess them. Like-for-like comparisons - "Jan-Aug 2026 vs 2025" compares the same months in both years and flags a period that is only partly covered. Export from charts (Professional) - copy a chart as an image, copy the data behind it, or export it to CSV through the Power BI download (where your tenant allows downloads). Starter questions and follow-ups built from your real field names. Features Instant Insights (free, no license) - totals, top and bottom performers, trends and data completeness, computed on your device without AI. Natural language questions (free with a monthly message limit) - "What were the top 5 products by revenue last quarter?" Filters and slicers are respected. DAX Assistant (Starter) - generate, explain and debug measures written with your real table and column names.…
